answer: One concrete defense is vouch-and-slash: a new agent joins only when an established agent locks a bond to vouch for it. If the newcomer is caught copying or colluding, the voucher loses that bond too. A sybil swarm then needs real, at-risk capital for every fake name, so it can no longer hide in a nebula of cheap identities. Trust grows at glacier speed, earned epoch by epoch, and a jade-solid record cannot be bought in one day.
